definitions.w_stu_chg_pp: (ending stocks / total use) of newest marketing year, current WASDE minus previous-month WASDE, percentage points; first-projection months excluded; original published vintage; obs 12:00 ET release day; t0 = same session
definitions.c_ge_chg_pp: change in national (18-state) good+excellent % vs previous weekly Crop Progress release (5-10 days apart); obs Monday 16:00 ET; t0 = next session
definitions.d_belt_d1_chg_pp: change in mean D1-or-worse area % across IA,IL,IN,NE,MN vs previous USDM map; obs Thursday 08:30 ET (map date + 2d); Apr-Sep only; latest-vintage data (not contemporaneous)
definitions.e_dist_stock_surprise_kbbl: weekly change in US distillate stocks minus mean change in same week of prior 5 years (364-day steps); obs Wed 10:30 ET (Thu if Monday holiday); latest-vintage
definitions.e_crude_stock_surprise_kbbl: same for commercial crude stocks excluding SPR
definitions.e_util_chg_pp: weekly change in refinery utilization, percentage points
definitions.t_ho_ret20: 20-session return of front-month heating oil to last session of month; obs 16:00 ET; t0 = next session
definitions.t_cf_rel_spy_ret20: 20-session return of CF Industries minus SPY, same timing

target_definitions.pre: close(t0-1)/close(t0-6)-1 (anticipation; prices moving before the information)

baseline: targets minus the unconditional same-horizon mean return of the same calendar month over discovery years 2007-2012 (pre target not demeaned)
statistic: Spearman rank correlation (robust to futures roll gaps), two-sided p from 2000 permutations of feature values within calendar-month strata; seed fixed
multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg q=0.10 across every (feature,commodity,target) test in the split; all tests are reported whether or not significant
support_rule: SUPPORTED = FDR-significant in validation with the expected sign AND same sign in hold-out (one-sided p<0.10). SUGGESTIVE = validation nominal p<0.05 same sign as discovery, not FDR. Otherwise UNSUPPORTED. A pre-target (anticipation) result means the market moved first; it is reported, not counted as support for a leading indicator.
data_caveats: Yahoo continuous front-month futures contain roll gaps; rank statistic limits their influence but does not remove them
USDM and EIA series are latest-vintage; WASDE and Crop Progress are original published vintages
World Bank Pink Sheet is latest-vintage, excluded from predictive tests
Qualification-lane years 2019-2022 are used here only as this module's hold-out for indicator tests; no bot evaluation is run on them
